result:
Round 214 **PASSES**: all 9 rows I could check passed, with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true. I found no bugs, but B needs to rule on three deviations from the task text in A's work. I didn't change any app source, and the store tree is the same as when I started.

| Row | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SCOPE-214 | PASS | HEAD `fe556fd`; only the 5 granted files are modified and the 3 new files added; the frozen-file hash check returns 0 at start and end. Each granted file changes only what the task allows. |
| PERF-RUN-214 | PASS | `npm run test:perf` exited 0 (13.6 min). The new spec took 5.46 min against the 12 min limit, with no failures. Every one of its 144 rows was measured 3 times, and all count medians equal A's two runs. My second run of the new spec alone also exited 0, with no count differences. For the old perf test (PERF-1a), all 167 deterministic medians equal the round-212 reference in my own comparison. Both reports show React 18.3.1. The old test's `latest.json` was left byte-identical by the new spec's run. |
| PROBE-214 | PASS | I used my own commit counter on a production server at 1440×900. Components per move: range drag 101.283 and fade-in drag 96.367, exactly A's medians. While playing, no audio sources restart during the move; at release the range drag restarts 0 and the fade-in drag 1. |
| REDPROOF-214 | PASS | I ran three mutants of my own on a /tmp copy, and each failed with the expected failure text only. A's four mutant logs check out. |
| HYGIENE-214 | PASS | The React-version check fails when no renderer is found or the major version isn't 18. The "audio running" check now needs a running context and at least one `start()`. The fixed 2 s wait is gone from `selectClipGainMembers`; the other 2 s wait stays, as ruled. |
| DOC-214 | PASS | Every row id doc 168 cites exactly exists (79 of 79; 7 more are wildcard patterns). Its file:line references point at the right calls. Doc 167 no longer contains `antialiased`. |
| AN-REVIEW-214 | PASS | `npm run typecheck` returns 0. There is no `any`, no type assertion and no lint suppression. `npx biome check perf/` checks nothing under the repo config, so I ran Biome on a clean copy of `perf/` with a test config: 7 files, no issues. |
| G214-3 | PASS | At both sizes, a fresh session opens `/studio-lab` as the demo without sign-in. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. The token endpoint gives 401 with no header and 500 with a fake Bearer (the :5199 mock wasn't running, which the task allows). No token was issued. |
| STUDIO-SMOKE-214 | PASS | At both sizes: the fade-in goes 0 → 1.000 during the drag and adds one Undo entry ("Undo: Fade In"). Ctrl+Z restores it, and there are 0 page errors. |

The full test suite, build, full Biome, `npm run verify` and e2e smoke are left to the root gate; I don't claim them.

**For B to rule on:**
- **Range drag liveness check:** the task's `[data-range-end]` check can't work for a range dragged on a clip, because that attribute only appears for an all-tracks range (`ArrangementLane.tsx` l.1016). A instead checks that the end time in the clip's range label grows during the drag. My mutant shows that check fails when it should. I recommend accepting it.
- **Clip-click liveness check (minor):** the Clip Gain fader is always on screen, so A uses enabled/disabled to show the clip was selected.
- **`interact.harness.audio-running` (minor):** this row is measured at normal CPU speed only, with no 6× version, even though play is measured at both rates. At 6× a play that doesn't start still fails the run.
- **Biome on `perf/` (info, already true before this round):** `npx biome check perf/` checks nothing under the repo config. A future task should say so, or root could change `biome.json` (it is protected).

My probe confirms the drag numbers B will use at round 216 planning: the range drag re-renders about 98 components per move, and with 30 clips a fade-in release restarts 30 sources.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-214.md
- c-round-214.json
- c-round-214/
